descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S12 「房间/单元顺序的边界，两个模式：2/9/10/12/100、'4B-3' 对 '4B-12'、空房间、同一房间三个病人」 Room/unit order edges, both contexts: 2/9/10/12/100, '4B-3' vs '4B-12', blank room, three patients in one room

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U3 Room is the primary sort: the list opens in room order, in both contexts (ticket How-it-works step 3: 'Room is the primary/default sort').（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4）
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Hospital: room order differs from name order, one patient with no room (as a scan leaves it), and three patients sharing room 12 created in reverse name order with different statuses. Nursing Home on Today's Visits: unit labels as a facility writes them, one resident with no unit, and three residents sharing 'Rm 12' c …

When Hospital: open the list without choosing a sort; choose name; choose room again. Nursing Home: open Today's Visits without choosing a sort; then All Residents

Then Hospital room order puts 2, 9, 10, 12, 100 in numeric order and 4B-3 before 4B-12. Name order is Allen … Young. Switching back restores room order. NH: within the same unit label, rooms are numeric (Rm 3 before Rm 12; Rm 2 before Rm 12) in both views

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Hospital cp1/cp3 mustAppearInOrder [Young, Xu, Wells, Upton], [Wells, Carter, Upton], [Wells, Bishop, Upton], [Wells, Allen, Upton], [Tran, Shah]; cp2 mustAppearInOrder [Allen, Bishop, Carter, Reyes, Shah, Tran, Upton, Wells, Xu, Young] (U2, U3). NH cp4/cp5 mustAppearInOrder [Baker, Abbott], [Young, Carter], [Young, Bishop], [Young, Allen] (U7, U3). …
